run_similarity_search: run a LASER similarity search across multilingual sentence embeddings using FAISS FlatL2 index
create_faiss_index: create a FAISS FlatL2 index from encoded sentence embeddings for similarity search
encode_sentences: encode sentences to multilingual embeddings using a LASER SentenceEncoder model
tokenize_and_bpe: tokenize text and apply BPE subword encoding for a given language
search_multiple_indices: search across multiple language-specific FAISS indices and print a confusion matrix
